prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE SQUARE memory-card PNG, an expert maritime illustrator's finished coloured-pencil, graphite and restrained watercolour sketch.
Reference is STYLE AND FRAMING ONLY: match the Titanic image's fine pencil strokes, hatching, paper highlights, soft upper-left light and ivory paper. Draw the NEW ship below.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: SMALL CENTRED subject on a big blank square page. Whole vessel fits in the CENTRAL 60% of width AND height. Leave broad empty ivory paper: about ONE FIFTH of the page on each of the four sides. Include every mast, bowsprit, sail and stern. Do not fill the page. No border.
One complete upright vessel as an above-water waterline portrait, intact in working heyday. Neat waterline edge, no visible underwater keel. Entire background is the same subtle warm ivory drawing paper edge to edge. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, flags, signature or watermark; NO water, ocean, sky, horizon, scenery, wake, smoke, shadows, people or other vessels. Detailed natural colours and recognisable geometry, visibly hand drawn, not photo, CGI, toy, cartoon or vector.
Subject and view: Vasa. 1628 Swedish wooden warship as intact afloat, THREE masts, ivory square sails lightly set, extremely tall elaborate red stern covered in restrained gilded carved figures, two tiers of gunports, warm oak hull with red and gold ornament, long beakhead and bowsprit. Historically inspired reconstruction rather than dark museum wreck. View: starboard quarter; stern lower left, bow upper right. Keep the whole vessel upright, centred and within the central 68% of BOTH dimensions, generous blank paper on every side.

edits.prompt: Edit this sailing-ship sketch with ONE change: uniformly SHRINK the ENTIRE ship, including every sail, mast, rigging line and bowsprit, to 80% of its CURRENT size, centred on the SAME square ivory page. Preserve ALL shapes, colours, details, viewing direction and fine coloured-pencil texture exactly. Extend the identical blank paper seamlessly. Leave at least 15% entirely blank paper on EVERY side of the complete silhouette. No text, water, border or anything added.

review: Full-size visually reviewed; complete masts and sails, distinctive hull colours, clear safe margins.
